name: Breadcrumb
purpose: Represent the current page's ancestry as a named navigation landmark and ordered hierarchy.
useWhen: The current page belongs to a hierarchy and users may navigate to ancestor pages.

avoidWhen.condition: The choices are result pages or a general destination list.

composition: Compose Root > List > Item containing ancestor Link or the single current Page, with decorative Separator parts between items.

rules.statement: Render one non-link Page for the current location and use links only for ancestors.
When Ellipsis opens hidden pages, compose it with a real named button.

commonMistakes.mistake: Making the current page another link or placing separators outside the ordered list.
commonMistakes.correction: Use Page once and keep Item and Separator parts inside List.

validation: Confirm the nav has a useful accessible name and one aria-current page.
Confirm separators are absent from the accessibility tree.
